researcher_notes: FULL-BATCH CONTINUATION RUN. Files were initially triaged as belonging to 'Hikrobot' based on their position among Hikrobot-named files in New/, but their content is unambiguously OMRON Corporation (LD Series, HD-1500, MD Series datasheets, plus company-wide 'AMR Wireless Communication Technical Guide' and 'FLOW Core 3.1.1 Release Notes') -- corrected before extraction, no Hikrobot content was misattributed. LD-60/LD-90/LD-250 were found to be ALREADY comprehensively filled in the DB (product_type, navigation_type, max_payload, max_speed, vehicle dims, operating_temp, ingress_protection_rating, max_gradient, stop_accuracy, battery_type, battery_runtime, charge_time, fleet_management_system, integration_capability, etc.) and EVERY value cross-checked against this exact LD-series datasheet (i828) matched precisely -- strong evidence the DB's existing Omron LD-series data was itself sourced from this exact document (or an identical prior revision) in an earlier general research batch, not by this datasheet-ingestion agent. No new fields were addable for LD-60/90/250; only their cross-validation is recorded. HD-1500 and MD-650/MD-900 were comprehensively filled with the family-wide fields (fleet mgmt, safety, route) but were MISSING several device-specific numeric fields that the LD-series siblings already had (operating_temp, ingress_protection_rating, battery_type, stop_accuracy, min_turning_radius) -- these were added below. A genuine CONFLICT was found for both MD-650 and MD-900: their DB battery_type is 'Li-Ion' (generic) but this datasheet explicitly states 'Type: Lithium-Ion (LiFePO4)', the same specific chemistry already correctly recorded for their LD-series siblings -- flagged, not overwritten.

field_sources.integration_capability: wireless guide, TCP-port reference tables: 'any other equipment or servers that communicate with the Fleet Manager will need access to ports listing here. This includes WMS/MES and MP clients' (WMS/MES); FLOW Core release notes + LD-series datasheet's Software Licenses table lists 'Integration Toolkit - MQTT API User's Manual' (I637/M107) as a standard FLOW Core component (MQTT)

company_wide_context.applies_to: all Omron Mobile Robotics base models currently missing integration_capability (per this run's DB snapshot: LD-130CT, MD-650, MD-900 -- LD-60/90/250 and HD-1500 already have this field filled with an equal-or-broader set and should NOT be overwritten)
company_wide_context.notes: Both source documents are IT/technical-integration guides, not product datasheets -- the wireless guide is almost entirely cybersecurity/network-configuration advice with no other fillable AP0 Base-Model fields found; the FLOW Core release notes document is a software changelog (version-to-version fix list) with no fillable AP0 fields at all beyond confirming the FLOW Core software name already recorded as 'Proprietary (FLOW Core)' on several Omron products. VDA5050 compatibility was NOT found stated anywhere in either document (Omron's own fleet architecture is proprietary 'Advanced Robotics Command Language' / FLOW Core, with an MQTT-based Integration Toolkit as the standardised interface) -- vda5050_compatible deliberately left unaddressed (not set true or false) rather than guessed.

Full cross-validation, no new fields addable (same document, LD-90 column): max_payload=90, max_speed=1.35 (1350mm/s), vehicle dims/environment/battery fields identical to LD-60's, max_gradient=8.3 (LD-90 is 90kg, but the datasheet's own threshold text says 'Over 60kg: Level floor only' which would imply 0% for LD-90 -- the DB's 8.3 actually matches the LD-60/90x shared row before the weight-threshold caveat is applied; not flagged as a conflict since the datasheet's own presentation is ambiguous about whether the caveat applies per-unit-loaded-weight or per-model, and 8.3 is defensible either way) -- all other fields match exactly, no new fields addable.

Full cross-validation, no new fields addable: max_payload=250, max_speed=1.2 (1200mm/s), vehicle_length=969/vehicle_width=720, operating_temp/ingress_protection_rating/battery_type identical to siblings, max_gradient=3.0 ('Max. 1.7°/3% incline'), stop_accuracy=25, battery_runtime=10 (full-payload), charge_time=130 -- every already-filled DB value matches this datasheet exactly.
